Sri Aurobindo Ghosh translated the Indian national song "Vande Mataram" into English [d1, d9]. The song was originally written in Sanskrit and Bengali by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay [d1, d9]. This translation was first published on 20th November 1909 [d1, d9].
